title: Local Verification Gates
label: RUN CHECKS
kicker: Do not judge the first load too early. Wait for the selector, layer controls, map, and score panel, then verify the API and data mode.

cards.title: Dashboard loads
cards.body: Open http://127.0.0.1:8000 and wait for the app shell.

cards.title: Map renders
cards.body: Azure Maps or OpenStreetMap should render with route overlays.

cards.title: Districts appear
cards.body: The selector should show 10 districts and update the panel.

cards.title: Health endpoint
cards.body: Return a small OK response from FastAPI.

cards.title: Data status
cards.body: Confirm sample mode, counts, and fallback notes.

cards.title: Score endpoint
cards.body: Call or trigger the endpoint to confirm scoring.

cards.title: Validate data
cards.body: Run this when map layers or counts look wrong.

cards.title: Run tests
cards.body: Catch API, health, data-shape, and scoring regressions.

cards.title: Stay local first
cards.body: Move to cloud only after the local proof path is stable.

callout: Success signal: dashboard visible, overlays present, selector populated, score panel updating, /health OK, and /api/data-status explaining the active data source.
